$comment: Design tokens consumed by the demo app. Colors sampled visually from Ben's July 7 screenshots of sleeptopia.com (homepage). Values are close visual matches, good enough for demo fidelity; swap for pixel-exact values only if a screen looks off next to the real site.

brand.name: Sleeptopia
brand.siteDescriptor: Your End-To-End Sleep Apnea Service Provider

primaryNavy.role: headings, 'Sleep' in wordmark, nav link text

heroNavy.role: hero overlay cards, dark panels, footers

brandBlue.role: primary CTA pill buttons (Browse HSTs, Book An Appointment)

skyBlue.role: 'topia' in wordmark, logo mark front, eyebrow text

success.role: positive outcomes, adherence-good (demo addition, not on site)

heading.note: Site headings are a bold rounded sans (visual match: Fredoka/Baloo 2). Close match, not confirmed — if Ben pastes the fonts.googleapis URL from page source we pin it exactly.

body.note: Site body is a clean humanist sans; Source Sans 3 is a close match.

shape.buttonStyle: pill, solid brandBlue, white text; purple variant for external/portal actions

logo.construction: Rounded plus-cross mark: heroNavy plus offset lower-left behind a skyBlue plus; wordmark 'Sleep' in primaryNavy + 'topia' in skyBlue, rounded heading font
logo.note: Faithful recreation from screenshots at header sizes. Optional: drop the site's original file over these paths for pixel-exact fidelity.

siteStructureReference.$comment: Observed on sleeptopia.com — reuse for demo authenticity
siteStructureReference.heroPattern: Dark navy card over lifestyle photo; question header 'What Brought You Here Today?' + 4 pill CTAs (I Snore / I Can't Fall Asleep / Sleep Apnea Info / Home Sleep Testing)
siteStructureReference.stepPattern: 'One. Two. Done.' eyebrow + numbered steps with purple 'Step N:' labels
siteStructureReference.demoHook: Site already sells 'Mattress & Pillows' — the Mattress Hub partnership extends an existing category; use this in the demo narrative

coBranding.rule: Sleeptopia primary throughout; The Mattress Hub appears on retail-door screens and footer co-brand line: 'Sleeptopia × The Mattress Hub'
